## [Inline rendering with document​.currentScript](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/17/document-currentscript/)
*Simon Willison's Blog* | 17/10/2026 | Score: 0.56
Tags: api_update

> Inline rendering with document​.currentScript Lean Rada describes a neat trick that takes advantage of the document.currentScript property. You can use that to drop in a tiny inline element that replaces itself when the page loads: The year is document.currentScript.replaceWith( new Date().getFullYear()) If you define a shortcut function like this: $=(...n)=>document.currentScript.replaceWith(...n) You get a tiny template language: The year is $(new Date().getFullYear()) Tags: javascript
